subject: physics
content: The side of a cube is measured by vernier callipers (10 divisions of a vernier scale coincide with 9 divisions of main scale, where 1 division of main scale is 1 mm). The main scale reads 10 mm and first division of vernier scale coincides with the main scale; Mass of the cube is 2.736 g. Find the density of the cube in appropriate significant figures.
